 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep Kumar
 Oral Order
3 03-09-2025
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP for the State and the learned counsel for the informant.
2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in connection with Bypass P.S. Case No. 39 of 2025 registered for the offence under Sections 376, 313, 506, 328/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has not committed any offence.
4. Learned A.P.P. for the State has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
5. The allegation against the petitioner is of committing rape upon a married woman.
The FIR has been Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41772 of 2025(3) dt.03-09-2025 registered after one year.
From the reading of the FIR, it appears to be a case of consensual sex.
